title: Onboard stability canvas - 21d
content:
Purpose:
This is a practical 21-day stability canvas for new engineering and product hires that need a fast, measurable ramp while minimizing churn risk. Intended for People Ops partnering with hiring managers and mentors. Not a replacement for longer-term 90d plans — this is focused on the first 3 weeks where errors in access, expectations, or scope cause the majority of early friction.

Quick summary (one line):
A lightweight, repeatable sprint for role activation that blends immediate tactical onboarding (access, smallest-meaningful-ticket, test deployment) with a weekly health-check cadence and an explicit fallback plan.

Goals (what success looks like at 21d):
- New hire can complete and merge a scoped PR or deliver a documented customer-facing microtask end-to-end (dev->test->deploy) depending on role.
- Core accesses validated: repo, CI, infra console, Slack, calendar, internal wiki.
- Mentor and manager agree on 3 measurable signals for role proficiency.
- New hire reports "safe and productive" in the day-21 pulse (async).

Signals & metrics (track these):
- Access pass rate (target 100% by day 3).
- First-PR cycle time (target <72h from initial PR to merge for the scaffolded task).
- Mentor touchpoints completed (target 6 short syncs across 21d).
- Day-7 and Day-21 self-rated confidence (1-5).
- Escalation events (count; target 0).

21-day schedule (recommended, adjustable by role):
- Day 0 (pre-start checklist): laptop provisioned, SSO invite sent, calendar slot for first-day orientation, Slack channel created, HW shipping note, T-shirt + welcome note.
- Day 1: Orientation (30m People Ops intro), manager 1:1 (30m goals), setup sprint (repo clone, test token, credentials), small doc task assigned.
- Days 2-3: Access verification window (CI run, deploy sandbox), mentor pairing session 1 (30m, walkthrough of codebase), ticket assigned: "first small fix or doc PR".
- Days 4-7: Paired work and async feedback, manager check-in (15m), week-1 pulse (form).
- Days 8-14: Gradually increase ticket complexity, first independent deploy if applicable, mentor syncs 2–3, cross-team intro calls.
- Days 15-18: Role-specific challenge (short scoped project delivering measurable output), manager triage on blockers.
- Days 19-21: Finalize challenge, day-21 pulse + written feedback form, retention & risk signal review, calibrate next 30/60/90 commitments.

Core artifacts to produce during 21d:
- One merged PR or a documented micro-deliverable with steps and verification notes.
- Access matrix (spreadsheet) with green/yellow/red per system and owner.
- Day-7 and Day-21 pulse results stored in People Ops tracker (link to JIRA:PEOPLE-284).

Mentor playbook (short):
- Role: Mentor is a senior peer assigned for 21 days to reduce cognitive load and unblock the new hire.
- Cadence: 30m onboarding walkthrough on day 2; 3x 30m paired sessions across week 1–2; ad-hoc 15m slots for quick unblock; day-21 retro (30m).
- Deliverables: A checklist sign-off on access + a simple annotated runbook ("how I debug X locally").

Manager responsibilities (first 21d):
- Define the smallest meaningful first deliverable and accept criteria prior to start day.
- Block calendar time for 30m weekly syncs.
- Ensure mentor is prepared and aligned to goals.
- Triage any cross-team access or policy escalations within 48h.

Risk matrix and mitigation (top short-term risks):
- Missing access to critical systems: Mitigate with an access-owner escalation list and a backup OOB login for the first 72h.
- Overwhelming scope: Mitigate by making the first deliverable a narrow scoped task and using guardrails (rubric for acceptance).
- Isolation / culture friction: Mitigate by scheduling cross-functional intros and a "buddy" lunch in week 2.
- Early technical regression (blocked by infra): Use temporary sandbox or a mocked path for early development.

Checklist (practical, copyable):
- Pre-start: laptop + VPN config + SSO + MFA enabled.
- Day 1: Slack invite + calendar orientation + intro messages posted in team channel.
- Day 2: Repo clone verified + CI run successful.
- Day 3: Test deploy (or smoke test) completed.
- Day 7: First PR merged (or doc deliverable accepted).
- Day 14: Independent small deploy OR signed handoff for CI job.
- Day 21: Day-21 pulse + final deliverable + manager+mentor sign-off.

Interview rubric tie-ins (how hiring decisions map to this canvas):
- During offer stage, capture 3 role-critical skills that will be checked during the 21d sprint.
- Create a mini acceptance rubric for the initial deliverable (pass/fail + confidence score).
- When candidates are borderline, use a trial project flag and a clear accelerant plan tied to extra mentor time.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should we require a 24h prestart "hardware readiness" confirmation email? (Owner: People Ops)
- How to integrate this canvas with Dedicated onboarding flows for non-cloud infra teams? (Owner: Eng infra)
- Build a templated day-7 PR label that auto-populates the People Ops tracker. (JIRA:PEOPLE-300)

Appendix: templates and quick links:
- Day-7 pulse form template: confluence:HR/pulse-templates/day7
- Access-owner matrix template (sheet): confluence:HR/templates/access-matrix-compact
- New-joiner Slack welcome script (copy): "Welcome NAME! Quick intros: ..."

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally tactical and minimal; please comment on handoff owners and whether the 21d deliverable targets feel realistic for SRE vs. frontend vs. product design roles.
- If approved, People Ops will run a two-team pilot (Eng Serving Runtime + Console) in Q4 and iterate based on day-21 retention signals.

End of doc.
